annotations.title: Diff SF-30 RFP Amendments & Q&A Logs Against Base Solicitation

description: Diff base RFP/SOW text against subsequent SF-30 Solicitation Amendments, SLED Addenda, and official Government Q&A logs to flag altered `shall`/`must` mandates, deadline extensions, page-limit revisions, CLIN pricing changes, de-facto Q&A requirements, and invalidated proposal sections with Shipley redraft language. This is a read-only, stateless change-impact analysis call (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `base_solicitation_text` and `amendment_or_qa_text` accept up to 100,000 characters each, and providing optional `current_proposal_outline` enables targeted auditing of which specific drafted proposal volumes/pages are invalidated). Use this tool whenever an agency issues an SF-30 amendment, addendum, or Q&A response matrix after initial RFP release; use `generate_compliance_matrix` instead when shredding an initial base RFP for the first time.

amendment_or_qa_text.description: Subsequent SF-30 Amendment text, state/local SLED Addendum text, or official Contracting Officer Q&A clarification matrix to diff against the base solicitation.

base_solicitation_text.description: Original base RFP text from Section B (CLINs), Section C/PWS (Statement of Work), Section L (Instructions/Deadlines/Page Limits), or Section M (Evaluation Criteria).

current_proposal_outline.default: Volume I: Technical Approach & Architecture; Volume II: Management & Key Personnel Staffing; Volume III: Past Performance; Volume IV: CLIN Pricing & Basis of Estimate (BOE)
current_proposal_outline.description: Optional summary of the bidder's in-progress proposal outline, volume page allocations, or technical baseline used to pinpoint exact sections that must be rewritten.

name: analyze_rfp_amendment_diff

amendment_impact_summary.description: Executive roll-up of amendment severity, rework risk score, deadline shifts, and mandatory SF-30 acknowledgment rules.

invalidated_proposal_sections.description: Bidder proposal sections invalidated by the amendment, paired with ready-to-paste replacement narrative.

qa_clarification_rulings.description: Structured breakdown of Government Q&A answers, flagging hidden de-facto requirements and competitive impacts.

requirement_and_clin_deltas.description: Ordered list of material requirement, CLIN pricing, page limit, evaluation criteria, and deadline changes.
